import os, sys, csv, collections
R = "/data/tk048/tk040-b14"
OUT = "/data/j180/agg.csv"
acc = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0]*6)
nfiles = 0
for mon in sorted(os.listdir(R)):
    b5 = os.path.join(R, mon, "b5")
    if not os.path.isdir(b5):
        continue
    for st in sorted(os.listdir(b5)):
        sp = os.path.join(b5, st)
        if not os.path.isdir(sp):
            continue
        for day in sorted(os.listdir(sp)):
            dp = os.path.join(sp, day)
            if not os.path.isdir(dp):
                continue
            for cell in os.listdir(dp):
                f = os.path.join(dp, cell, "forms.csv")
                if not os.path.isfile(f):
                    continue
                nfiles += 1
                with open(f) as fh:
                    rd = csv.reader(l for l in fh if not l.startswith("#"))
                    hdr = next(rd, None)
                    if not hdr:
                        continue
                    ix = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(hdr)}
                    for r in rd:
                        a = acc[(mon, st, cell, r[ix["form"]])]
                        a[0] += 1
                        a[1] += int(r[ix["n_signals"]])
                        a[2] += int(r[ix["n_fills"]])
                        a[3] += float(r[ix["sum_net_bps"]])
                        a[4] += int(r[ix["n_submitted"]])
                        a[5] += 1 if r[ix["incomplete"]] == "true" else 0
with open(OUT + ".tmp", "w") as o:
    o.write("month,set,cell,form,symdays,n_signals,n_fills,sum_net_bps,n_submitted,n_incomplete\n")
    for k in sorted(acc):
        a = acc[k]
        o.write("%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%d,%d,%.6f,%d,%d\n" % (k + tuple(a)))
os.rename(OUT + ".tmp", OUT)
print("files", nfiles, "keys", len(acc))
